transitions.name: status-bar
transitions.motion: Zero-second requests use immediate window policy; other changes use the system bar fade. Screen-off, resume, user-present and status-bar control regain restore a hidden home bar immediately.
transitions.verification: StatusBarFaderTest and StatusBarLifecycleScreensTest; system compositor and unlock must be checked on a device

transitions.name: settings-navigation
transitions.motion: Material AppMotion offset and effects; full container Start forward, End on pop
transitions.verification: MenuMotionScreensTest intermediate measured positions; AppScreensTest actual destinations

transitions.name: button-search-field
transitions.motion: One Material slide/fade from above for the top field and below for the bottom field; bottom placement follows IME insets
transitions.verification: MenuMotionScreensTest intermediate positions; UserFlowScreensTest real search entry

transitions.name: widget-and-app-menus
transitions.motion: Stock expressive DropdownMenuPopup and grouped shapes
transitions.verification: MenuMotionScreensTest rendered widget menu; no device frame-time claim

transitions.name: notification-sheet
transitions.motion: Stock ModalBottomSheet shared with calendar/weather; explicit close hides before removing owner. When the last notification goes, the sheet closes at once and keeps its last rows while it slides away, so it never folds to an empty page first; a sheet opened empty stays open.
transitions.verification: NotificationScreensTest light/dark/large text; NotificationSheetBehaviourTest clear-all and opened-empty; WeatherScreensTest shared viewport; UserFlowScreensTest actual sheet entry

transitions.name: corner-button-press
transitions.motion: Stock ripple, clipped to the button's own outline (circle or squircle) so it never spills into the square around it
transitions.verification: Compiles against the shared outline used by the face; the ripple itself must be checked on a device
